GTLS is a direct LNG/cryogenic equipment mapping and may be more project-backlog sensitive than compression fleet names; include in later LNG infrastructure pass.
MRC is a lower-attention PVF distribution candidate for gas utility, pipeline, LNG, and industrial infrastructure, but exposure purity requires segment-level verification.
